objective: Implement an opt-in durable incident journal that verifies canonical source/target/time/sequence-bound HMAC observations and preserves unresolved incidents across restart; require explicit independently MAC-authenticated manual resolution. No live collector or production qualification.
nonGoals: No production telemetry ingestion, always-on collector, dashboard, paid vendor or external project access
No automatic closure of an anomaly after healthy telemetry, no unverified operator acknowledgement
No assumption that an HMAC reference secret authenticates a production device without independent key custody
decisions: Use single-host local SQLite event and incident store with MAC-bound telemetry and protected manual resolve path.
Per-target/domain strictly increasing sequence and freshness reject replay, while external transport/key lifecycle remains a separate adapter requirement.

obligations.description: Reject wrong source/target/environment, stale/future event, replays, malformed IDs, wrong MAC and out-of-order sequence.
Create unresolved incident on nonhealthy event; maintain unresolved status through healthy follow-up and process restart.
Require scoped authenticated operator and recovery evidence digest for manual close; no auto-close.

structure: src/sf/live_journal.py: authenticated observation validation and SQLite incident history
tests/test_live_journal.py: persistence, replay, staleness, unresolved healthy follow-up
impact: Standalone operations reference library; SF-16 unauthenticated fixture contract unaffected

budget.network: No actual live services; temporary SQLite/HMAC-only unit tests
budget.execution: Stable-candidate PR checks only; no duplicate Actions triggers

externalEffects: No actual telemetry connection, project deploy or provider credentials; only stacked PR changes
